goal: Confident spoken German for daily work in Switzerland: solid B2 in about 6 months, C1 for work topics in 12-15 months.
principles: Speaking first: every topic is taught through spoken chunks, and production tasks are spoken before they are written.
Chunks over rules: learn the phrase, notice the pattern, then generalise.
Spiral: a topic returns at a deeper level instead of being done once.
Errors feed the review deck; weak topics (mastery below 60%) trigger a sprint suggestion.
Original content only: this map is competence-based and does not copy any textbook.

days.what: See the pattern inside 5-6 spoken chunks and a short dialogue
Exercises on meaning and choice between similar forms
Speak it: answer prompts aloud, then use it with a colleague
Mixed check; misses become review cards

sprint_template.after: New words and mistakes join the normal FSRS review deck, so the topic keeps coming back for weeks.

grammar.title: Sentence building: verb second, inversion, Satzklammer
grammar.cando: I can build clear main clauses in the right order, also after an opening time or place phrase.
chunks: Heute möchte ich kurz etwas dazu sagen.

grammar.title: Perfekt and Präteritum in conversation
grammar.cando: I can talk about past events naturally: Perfekt for most verbs, Präteritum for sein, haben and modal verbs.

grammar.title: Subordinate clauses: weil, dass, wenn, obwohl
grammar.cando: I can give reasons, report content and set conditions with the verb at the end.
chunks: Ich komme später, weil ich noch einen Termin habe.
Ich denke, dass wir das heute klären können.

grammar.title: Modal verbs and everyday requests
grammar.cando: I can ask, offer and decline in everyday work situations.

grammar.title: Konjunktiv II: wishes, suggestions, politeness
grammar.cando: I can make polite requests, suggestions and hypothetical statements.
chunks: Ich würde vorschlagen, dass wir morgen weitermachen.
Wenn ich mehr Zeit hätte, würde ich das anders lösen.

grammar.title: Relative clauses (nominative, accusative, dative)
grammar.cando: I can describe people, things and situations with a relative clause.
chunks: Das ist der Kollege, der das Projekt leitet.
Das Problem, das wir haben, ist die Zeit.

grammar.title: Adjective endings
grammar.cando: I can use adjective endings correctly in common phrases.

grammar.title: Case and prepositions: two-way and fixed combinations
grammar.cando: I can choose the right case after common prepositions and verb-preposition pairs.

grammar.title: Reflexive and separable verbs
grammar.cando: I can use reflexive and separable verbs in main and subordinate clauses.

grammar.title: Passive: process and result
grammar.cando: I can say what is done without naming who does it.

grammar.title: Infinitive clauses: zu, um ... zu, ohne ... zu
grammar.cando: I can express purpose and attitude with infinitive clauses.
chunks: Ich nutze das Tool, um Zeit zu sparen.

grammar.title: Time links: als, wenn, seit, bevor, nachdem, während
grammar.cando: I can order events in time and choose between als and wenn.
chunks: Bevor wir anfangen, kurz eine Frage.
Nachdem ich die E-Mail gelesen hatte, habe ich angerufen.

grammar.title: Connectors in main clauses: deshalb, trotzdem, außerdem
grammar.cando: I can link ideas across sentences with the verb in second position.
chunks: Deshalb schlage ich vor, dass wir früher anfangen.
Trotzdem finde ich die Idee gut.

grammar.title: Comparison: je ... desto and degrees
grammar.cando: I can compare and grade things precisely.
chunks: Das ist deutlich einfacher als vorher.

grammar.title: Verb-preposition pairs and pronominal adverbs (darauf, worüber)
grammar.cando: I can ask and answer with da- and wo- words instead of repeating long phrases.

grammar.title: Passive extended: modal verbs, state passive, man
grammar.cando: I can use passive with modal verbs and tell a process from a state.

grammar.title: Konjunktiv II of the past
grammar.cando: I can talk about missed chances and regrets.
chunks: Ich hätte das früher sagen sollen.

grammar.title: Conditions: falls, sofern, es sei denn, unreal sentences
grammar.cando: I can state conditions and exceptions precisely.
chunks: Falls Sie Fragen haben, melden Sie sich.
Es sei denn, es gibt ein Problem.

grammar.title: Reasons, results, aims: da, zumal, sodass, damit
grammar.cando: I can justify decisions and state consequences and goals.
chunks: Da das Budget knapp ist, priorisieren wir.
Wir müssen das klären, damit es keine Missverständnisse gibt.

grammar.title: Contrast and concession: zwar ... aber, während, wohingegen
grammar.cando: I can weigh two sides and concede a point before arguing my own.
chunks: Das ist zwar aufwendig, aber sinnvoll.
Während A schnell ist, ist B genauer.

grammar.title: Genitive and prepositions with genitive: wegen, trotz, aufgrund
grammar.cando: I can use genitive prepositions in formal speech and writing.
chunks: Wegen der Verspätung fangen wir später an.
Aufgrund der aktuellen Lage ändern wir den Plan.

grammar.title: Relative clauses extended: preposition, was, wo, genitive
grammar.cando: I can build longer relative clauses without losing the thread.
chunks: Das Projekt, an dem ich arbeite, ist wichtig.
Alles, was du brauchst, ist hier.

grammar.title: Verb-noun phrases and fixed expressions (Funktionsverbgefüge)
grammar.cando: I can use typical formal verb-noun combinations instead of plain verbs.

grammar.title: Modal particles: doch, mal, eben, halt, ja
grammar.cando: I can soften or colour a sentence the way native speakers do.

grammar.title: Discourse markers and conversation strategies
grammar.cando: I can take time to think, change direction and correct myself smoothly.

grammar.title: Politeness and register: du/Sie, formal and informal
grammar.cando: I can adjust my language to the person and the situation.
chunks: Wären Sie so freundlich, mir das zu schicken?
Sag Bescheid, wenn du Zeit hast.

grammar.title: Word order in the middle field, stress and negation
grammar.cando: I can place pronouns, time, place and negation naturally.
chunks: Das habe ich dir doch gestern gesagt.
Nicht ich habe das entschieden, sondern das Team.

grammar.title: Indirect speech: Konjunktiv I and substitutes
grammar.cando: I can report what others said accurately and neutrally.
chunks: Er sagte, er habe keine Zeit.
Sie meint, das sei kein Problem.

grammar.title: Participial attributes and extended attributes
grammar.cando: I can read and use compact noun phrases with participles.

grammar.title: Nominalisation and nominal style
grammar.cando: I can switch between verbal and nominal style to fit formal contexts.

grammar.title: Reporting and referring: laut, zufolge, demnach
grammar.cando: I can attribute information to sources and mark my distance.
chunks: Laut dem Bericht ist das Projekt im Plan.

grammar.title: Nuance: lassen constructions, sein + zu, passive alternatives
grammar.cando: I can express possibility and necessity without modal verbs.

grammar.title: Arguing and weighing: supporting, limiting, concluding
grammar.cando: I can build a balanced argument and draw a clear conclusion aloud.
chunks: Einerseits spart das Zeit, andererseits kostet es Qualität.
Daraus folgt, dass wir umplanen müssen.

grammar.title: Precision: prefix verbs and word formation
grammar.cando: I can pick the exact verb and derive related words.
